assumption: TSA24/BC Stage A pilot supply area is a diagnostic scale, not a TSA supply estimate.
impact: All volumes scale linearly with this value.

assumption: Assortment matrix rows are per-hectare values; the pilot multiplies by the diagnostic area.
impact: Base volume is area x matrix volume; no additional yield expansion.

assumption: Roadside cost is the assortment matrix price_cad_m3 proxy, not a harvest/stumpage cost.
impact: Changes the profit margin; transport and processing remain explicit.

assumption: Residue volume uses the ledger 0.45 ODT/m3 basic density and 0.45 wet-basis moisture.
impact: Residue ODT is volume x 0.45; matrix species-specific residue_odt is not used.

assumption: Log moisture is set to the ledger green assumption because the matrix has no log moisture field.
impact: Only relevant if a moisture blend limit is enabled.

assumption: m3/y infeed is used directly; odt/y infeed is converted at 1/0.45 m3 per ODT; bdmt/y is rejected.
impact: PAP bdmt/y lines are duplicate alternatives of the m3/y log lines and are excluded.

assumption: Facility nameplate is the sum of the maximum normalized capacity per primary product; feedstock alternatives are not additive.
impact: Prevents counting the same FFCM line once per feedstock alternative.

assumption: Operating cost is converted to CAD/m3 infeed with the same line's outfeed ratio when the archive unit is per mbf, kwh, admt, odt, or t.
impact: No global mbf/kwh/admt conversion is assumed.

assumption: Product revenue uses parsed commodity prices and each line's outfeed mix.
impact: Mass prices are applied to odt/admt outfeed with an explicit flag.

assumption: The TSA24 supply node has no archive route to an FFCM transload hub; a 150 km access leg is added to the minimum facility-to-TL road distance.
impact: This is the primary transport uncertainty; it is not a Euclidean estimate.

assumption: Road cost uses BC_logging_truck for logs and BC_residue_truck for residue, with archive fuel and operating rates.
impact: No transload cost is applied because the diagnostic path is direct road.

assumption: FFCM route capacity is absent from the parsed route table; pilot transport links are uncapped.
impact: Add route capacity before interpreting congestion or rail/water limits.

assumption: Contracts are diagnostic: min=0 and max=facility nameplate.
impact: Contract compliance is reported but does not constrain the base pilot.

assumption: Unassigned supply carries a diagnostic penalty so that feasible supply is not silently dropped.
impact: The penalty is reported as a separate objective component.

assumption: Assortment sorts are dimension-only; no BC official grade equivalence is claimed.
impact: Grade eligibility is a feedstock-class/product screen, not a grade-quality test.

assumption: MKRF is not used anywhere in this pilot.
impact: No MKRF input or output is read or written.
